_doc: Bannerline input bindings, one table per device TYPE. Actions are the vocabulary js/input/commands.js, js/ui/lobby.js and js/ui/menunav.js understand. Keyboard codes are KeyboardEvent.code; mouse buttons are Mouse0 (left), Mouse1 (middle), Mouse2 (right); WheelUp/WheelDown. Gamepad names are the standard-mapping names in js/input/padmap.js (A B X Y LB RB LT RT View Menu L3 R3 DUp DDown DLeft DRight). Per-device-type overrides are saved in localStorage (bannerline.bindings.<type>) and merged over these. While the Barracks panel is open the keyboard's Q W E R / A S D F / Z X C V hire the twelve units in grid order instead (js/ui/barracks.js).

gamepad._doc: Left stick moves (moveDir), right stick aims (centred = auto-target). A attacks the nearest enemy (by a building: opens it). X Y B RB RT cast; LT + a skill button learns it. D-pad: down = Barracks (hire units), up = Drill Yard, left / right = use your first / second usable item. View = Outfitter, LB = Sanctum (pick a power, aim with the left stick, A casts, B cancels). Menu = pause. R3 looks at the next field, L3 snaps back to your hero. Menus: d-pad or left stick moves, A confirms (hold A in the Barracks to keep hiring), B goes back. navUp/navDown/navLeft/navRight are synthesised from the d-pad and the stick by js/input/gamepad.js.
